note: Soccer v25.0, 24/11/2026. Simulation: node workout/island/tools/soccer-v250-sim.mjs (full 11 v 11, the child proxy of the gameplay tools, 16 matches a stage, seeds 1000-1015, the same seeds in both columns). Browser: workout/island/tools/soccer-v250-touch.mjs (Chromium + SwiftShader, 844x390, CDP touches). The proxy does not tap the pitch and does not curl, so those two parts are not in the simulation.

tuningRuns.note: 8-12 matches a stage, stages 2 and 5, the same seeds as the v24.9 column of each run. What was tried before the shipped defence.

manToManFromEveryRole.finding: markers taken from passing lanes opened the middle: easier for the child. The shipped markers come only from covering zones.

tapPass.event: tap-pass to the tapped team-mate, ground pass

tapSpace.event: tap-pass, space, a through ball for the nearest runner

tapSwitch.event: switch (tap) to the tapped team-mate while the rival has the ball

corner.event: loft to the target for a team-mate
